text:
Lee among 47 cities tied for 18th in New Hampshire scam reports in June
By
W. S. SappLee was one of 47 New Hampshire cities tied for 18th out of 64 cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, based on one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
The city had no scam reports listed in the previous month.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to produce large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
